A point of view

The interesting part begins when the demo ends.

Agentic technology opens a new way to work: we can express a goal, coordinate tools, and learn from what happens next.

I’m interested in the practical questions underneath that promise. Who decides? What can an agent change? How do we know the result is sound? What happens when the answer is uncertain?

The best systems keep people informed, capable, and in control.

The questions I return to

Progress needs a point of view.

↗

Where should autonomy begin and end?

Useful boundaries let agents move quickly while leaving meaningful decisions with people.

◎

What counts as evidence?

A result is easier to trust when you can trace the work behind it and see where certainty runs out.

↺

How do systems get better?

Each run should make the next one clearer through feedback, reflection, and deliberate revision.
